title: Hair Follicle Lifecycle
subtitle: Phases and where each disease attacks

phases.name: Anagen
phases.detail: Active growth phase. ~90% of scalp hairs at any time. Length determined by anagen duration. Disrupted by: chemotherapy (anagen effluvium), radiation, severe systemic illness.

phases.name: Catagen
phases.detail: Regression phase. Follicle base detaches from dermal papilla. ~1-2% of hairs at any time.

phases.name: Telogen
phases.detail: Resting phase. Hair stays in follicle awaiting shedding. ~10% of scalp hairs. Increased by: illness, surgery, postpartum (~3 months later — telogen effluvium).

phases.name: Exogen
phases.detail: Active shedding of telogen hair, often preceded or followed by new anagen growth in same follicle.
